title: Experimental Java 26.2 protocol stack (not official support)

minecraft-data-overlay.upstreamNotes: PR #1344, stacked on PrismarineJS pc_26_2 / PR #1219
minecraft-data-overlay.wrapper: PrismarineJS/node-minecraft-data 1cdd2d17afbb3f03d97767611a22edb2c1ee6ff6 (tag 3.119.0) with data.js overlay for 26.2; typings were not regenerated

compatibilityIntent: This vendor tree is loaded only when the negotiated Java version is 26.2 (protocol 776). Official dependencies remain the default for 1.21.1, 1.21.11, 26.1 and other supported versions.

minecraft-data.note: Upstream LICENSE file was not present in the local experimental copy; package.json declares MIT.

notVendored.prismarine-chunk: official 1.41.0 with a 26.2→1.18/26.1 alias in dependency-patches.ts. 26.2 vs 26.1 protocol.json schemas for map_chunk, update_light, block_change, multi_block_change, tile_entity_data, chunk_biomes and unload_chunk are deep-equal. This supports sharing the 1.18 world decoder for those packet layouts; it is not a standalone vanilla field-layout report (packets.json has ids only) and does not by itself prove every palette/heightmap/light edge case.
notVendored.prismarine-physics: official 1.11.1 with majorVersion 26.2 treated as 26.1 only for feature-flag lookup (proportionalLiquidGravity, climbUsingJump). Without the alias, Physics() throws because lib/features.json lists those flags through 26.1 only and not 26.2. proportionalLiquidGravity is independently supported by a 127.0.0.1 vanilla 26.2 water-column capture: terminal vertical step ≈ -0.0249 blocks/tick matches gravity/16 with water inertia 0.8 (-0.005/0.2=-0.025), not independentLiquidGravity 0.02 (terminal -0.1). climbUsingJump remains unproven by a 26.2 ladder/jump trial. 26.2 entity_update_attributes key mapper is NOT the 26.1 table; it matches vanilla 26.2 attribute protocol ids (movement_speed=26, scale=30).
notVendored.note: instruments.json is the 26.2 note-block instrument enum (27) from vanilla reports/blocks.json note_block.properties.instrument order, used by mineflayer noteHeard. goatHornInstruments.json is the separate datapack/runtime registry (8) with ids 0-7 from a 127.0.0.1 vanilla 26.2 registry_data capture (ponder_goat_horn=4). windows.json is the 26.2 minecraft:menu table (25 menuIds plus player inventory -1). Slot counts for 19 of 26 entries were verified by vanilla open_window/window_items, including smithing=40 and crafter_3x3=46 (not 45). Still unverified: generic_9x1/2/4/5/6, lectern, merchant. mapIcons.json is vanilla map_decoration_type (35, trial_chambers=34). enchantments.json was copied from official 26.1 and independently confirmed id/name-equal to vanilla 26.2 registry_data (43). A local Purpur backend inserted paper:raw into chat_type, shifting later vanilla chat ids — static vanilla chat_type tables are not sufficient on Paper/Purpur; use runtime registry_data. Official 26.2 version manifest (sha1 09165f570b16394790c4e37c93b0918729615d17) publishes client and server jars only, no client_mappings/server_mappings.

strictProtocol.unknownSlotComponent: vendor minecraft-protocol createProtocol for 26.2 installs a throwing default on SlotComponent and entityMetadataEntry so compiled protodef cannot skip unknown types as void (0 bytes) and silently misalign the cursor. Evidence records kind, discriminator, remainingBytes only — no payload/NBT/item bytes.
